title: Everything that happens before your first question
intro: Eight steps stand between you and the interview. Here's exactly what each one involves so there are no surprises on the day.

download.title: Download the Desktop App
download.desc: To ensure a secure testing environment, all interviews must be taken on our dedicated desktop application. <dl>Download and install the LetsHyre app</dl> for your operating system.

signIn.title: Sign In to the App
signIn.desc: Launch the desktop app and log in with your candidate credentials. If you don't have an account yet, visit letshyre.ai to create a profile. Your account holds your interview slot, profile photo, and results.

dashboard.title: Start from Your Dashboard
dashboard.desc: After signing in you'll land on your personal dashboard showing your profile and available interview slots. Click Take Interview to begin — the app immediately runs a background security check before anything else opens.

clearEnv.title: Clear Your Environment
clearEnv.desc: The security scanner checks for applications that could compromise exam integrity — web browsers, screen recorders, AI assistants, and video-call tools. Any flagged app must be closed before you can proceed.
clearEnv.tip: Tip: close all other apps before clicking Take Interview

permissions.title: Grant Device Permissions
permissions.desc: You'll be prompted to allow access to your microphone, camera, and screen. All three are required for live proctoring. Grant each permission when your operating system asks — the interview cannot proceed without them.

verifyId.title: Verify Your Identity
verifyId.desc: Read a short statement aloud for voice registration, then allow the camera to take a live photo. Your live image is compared against the profile photo you uploaded when creating your account.
verifyId.tip: Tip: face the camera directly in a well-lit room

chooseRole.title: Choose Your Interview Role
chooseRole.desc: Select the position you're interviewing for. You can proceed with the role assigned during onboarding, or choose a different slot if multiple are available to you.

begin.title: Begin Your Interview
begin.desc: You're all set. The interview window opens in full-screen with screen recording active. Answer each question within the allocated time — you can navigate between questions before the session timer runs out.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.desc: Download the desktop app, sign in to your account, and click Take Interview when you're prepared.
